description: This is a unit test Java source file for the ApplyChargeToOverdueLoanInstallmentTasklet class, testing the behavior when applying charges to overdue loan installments.

classes.name: ApplyChargeToOverdueLoanInstallmentTaskletTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of ApplyChargeToOverdueLoanInstallmentTasklet, focusing on scenarios where there are no overdue installments and where overdue installments exist.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and creates an instance of the tasklet before each test.

methods.name: testExecute_WhenNoOverdueInstallments_ShouldNotApplyCharges
methods.description: Verifies that the tasklet does not attempt to apply charges when no overdue installments are found.

methods.name: testExecute_WhenOverdueInstallmentsExist_ShouldApplyCharges
methods.description: Verifies that the tasklet applies overdue charges when overdue installments are present.
